deskyard account link: make a new login link for a token account

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] account link USER

Makes a new login link for a token account (or a share), replacing its unused
one. The link works once.

Arguments:
  USER       string      required  username

Prints: the login link (https://host/link#dyl_…) alone on stdout; what it
  gives on stderr

Examples:
  deskyard account link anna

Where: on this machine, talking to the chosen server: the one -e SERVER/ (or -e SERVER/ENV) names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
